entities.name: Gimbal
entities.description: A gremlin artificer from Avishkar who fell into the Aether Reservoir, gained genius, and helped build combat vehicles against the Phyrexian invasion.

entities.name: Aether Reservoir
entities.description: Place on Kaladesh into which Gimbal fell.

entities.name: Project Golden Scale
entities.description: A large-scale construction of dinosaur-inspired combat vehicles to prepare for the Phyrexian invasion.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Invaders whose coming invasion Project Golden Scale prepared for.

events.summary: Gimbal falls into the Aether Reservoir and awakens with sudden ingenuity.
events.quote: he found something miraculous had happened

events.summary: Gimbal is brought in to work on Project Golden Scale and is given his name.
events.quote: It was also at this time that the gremlin was given the name "Gimbal."

relations.note: Worked on it, enhancing the deadliness of its aether weapons
relations.quote: Gimbal played a crucial role in enhancing the deadliness of the project's aether cannons
